capabilities: Render Google Material Icons inline via !icon[name] syntax
Render icons in Live Preview with click-to-edit raw syntax
Render icons in reading view and exported notes
Configure icon size and color via plugin settings
extras: Bundles the Material Icons font locally, so icons work offline with no network requests or API key. The README notes Source mode does not render icons, and includes troubleshooting for missing styles.css.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to embed icon glyphs inline in note text; users must use images or external icon snippets.
summary: Icon renderer that displays Google Material Icons inline in notes using !icon[name] syntax in Live Preview and reading view.
